description: Metered Parking Spaces is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. View full metadata Description This polygon layer contains metered street parking spaces in the City of Cambridge. About Edit Dates This data is automatically updated on a set schedule. The Socrata edit date may not reflect the actual edit dates in the data. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking meter, parking. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: Cambridge GIS. The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
